The 0004 workhorse slices and chops through the toughest outdoor and bushcraft challenges. Its clip point blade uses premium Cru-Wear, a tough and easy-to-sharpen steel in the field. Easily control the canvas micarta handle, which is 3D-machined and contoured for your hand. Use an Allen wrench to strip the knife down for easy cleaning and reveal the skeletonized steel tang, ready for paracord wrapping. Carry the 0004 in multiple configurations using a Kansas-made, saddle tan leather sheath, storing the ultimate tool for your journey.

  • Full-tang work and bushcraft fixed blade; made in USA with American and global materials
  • CPM Cru-Wear steel provides superior edge retention, toughness, and ease of sharpening; dark bronze Cerakote coating for added blade protection
  • Natural canvas micarta handle; 3D-machined, contoured surface comfortably fills the hand
  • Full grain, vegetable-tanned saddle tan leather sheath for left/right belt and scout carry; belt loop, Tek-Lok compatibility, and debossed ZT logos on both sides

Please note that leather and micarta are natural materials and can vary in both color and finish.
